result.summary: The image depicts a wide residential intersection where a pedestrian is crossing the main roadway without the protection of a marked crosswalk or signal. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of high-visibility infrastructure and the presence of parked vehicles obstructing sightlines create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Main Crossing
hazards.description: The pedestrian is crossing the primary roadway at a location where crosswalk markings are absent or completely worn away, providing no visual guidance to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the pedestrian is walking across the main road.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the line of sight between approaching motorists and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the left side of the image near the intersection.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible patching and uneven road surface in the middle of the intersection could cause tripping hazards or affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Continental Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility 'continental' style crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and improve visibility by preventing cars from parking too close to the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing warning signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection features faded zebra crosswalks and a stop sign, but lacks continuous, well-maintained sidewalks on all sides. The pavement is in poor condition with visible cracking, and a large blurred area in the image obscures critical details of the crossing environment.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: Lack of a paved walkway on the left side forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface near the crossing area presents a trip hazard.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

The environment is primarily residential with wide roadways that may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
